reviews.text: Came here to get items to celebrate my girl's 5th birthday. Walking into the store, we felt at home, and were taken care of by Nicole and Jen, extremely courteous and professionalism was STRONG. We will be back!
The place was lovely, I loved it, and the cake was gorgeous; my dog ​​loved it. I highly recommend it!
I got the PB banana pupcake for my cat and he really enjoyed it he tried to eat the whole thing😹 the people were friendly there, I will be coming back for more treats for my cat or he will hate me …

Updating my review from 2 years ago:
We’ve been taking our dog Tripp here almost every week for 7 years. It’s her favorite place on Earth! The treats are so creative and delicious, but it’s really the staff that make this place special. They spoil all their customers and treat every pup like their own! I can’t say enough good things about this business. This is the place we’ve missed most since moving out of Houston!

First time here and my LAST time. The bottom of my dogs treat was COVEREDDDDD in hairy mold!! Thank goodness I looked at it bc I noticed a foul smell beware this is so dangerous no wonder my dog didn’t eat anything today after she had some of this the day before
Excellent place to take your pet.
It's an excellent place with great service and the staff are lovely people. I recommend it to everyone.
Threw my dog a birthday party! The cake was a good size and many of the dogs loved it! I added dog friendly whip cream to it!

Don’t love that they were dishonest about what we bought. I asked for a freshly made cake and ended up getting a frozen one. So my pup couldn’t even enjoy his cake on his bday. Partly my fault for not checking but really wish they would have said they didn’t have any than giving me something I didn’t want.
